inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, example recipe, Hugo config, author metadata, content counts, static assets, and deployment workflow

anchors.why: Defines where recipe files go, filename conventions, tag reuse, image policy, author metadata, and licensing posture.
Shows required frontmatter and simple body sections for title, tags, date, author, ingredients, and ordered directions.
Keeps author identity and donation/contact metadata outside recipe notes while linking by frontmatter author key.
Hugo configuration shows repo Markdown as the source and website generation as a separate publish surface.
Push-to-server workflow rebuilds the generated site from the repository without changing source semantics.

known_limits: The cooking content itself is not VAKS evidence and should not be imported as knowledge.
The repository's public-domain/content policy is source-specific and should not become a VAKS default.
The publish workflow is operational inspiration only; VAKS should not auto-deploy or auto-promote candidate notes.
